qc.label_under_test: the marker of exceptionality inside an emphatic adjective (EXTRA-ordinary, INC-RED-IBLE, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно)

neighbours.label: A piece partway through an extreme verdict word or phrase, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: inner chunks of a long or ALL-CAPS intense adjective or adverb split into several tokens (INC-RED-IBLE, F-ANT-ASTIC, HORR-IBLE, extra-ordinary, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно) and the opening words of a superlative idiom after a praising lead-in (state- of the art, world-class, show-stopping, out of this world). Quiet on intense words that arrive as one whole token (amazing, incredible, breathtaking), on mild verdicts (mediocre, pretty good), and on the same opening words used literally (the top of the hill, around the world).
fire: The concert last night was absolutely INCREDIBLE, I still can't stop thinking about it.
Honestly, that dessert was FANTASTIC and I want the recipe.
The service at that hotel was HORRIBLE from start to finish.
Her performance in the final act was truly extraordinary.
Этот фильм просто замечательный, советую всем.
Задача оказалась чрезвычайно сложной для всей команды.
Their new lab is packed with state-of-the-art equipment that rivals any university.
We were lucky to train under a world-class coach for the whole summer.
quiet: The concert last night was amazing, I still can't stop thinking about it.
Honestly, that dessert was pretty good and I might ask for the recipe.
The service at that hotel was mediocre from start to finish.
Her performance in the final act was fine.
Этот фильм просто хороший, можно посмотреть.
Задача оказалась сложной для всей команды.
Their new lab is on the second floor of the old science building.
We were lucky to train with a local coach for the whole summer.

predictions: Most split/caps items fire; lowercase 'extraordinary' may be one whole token and miss; near misses quiet.
